title: Isolation of Nuclei from Adult Human Brain Tissue
author: LeinU01 BRAIN Grant
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ztqf6mw
materials: Isolation of Nuclei from Adult Human Brain Tissue
2 M Potassium Chloride, RNase free (KCl; Ambion/Thermo Fisher Scientific AM9640G)
1 M Magnesium Chloride, RNase free (MgCl2; Ambion/Thermo Fisher Scientific AM9530G)
1 M Tris Buffer, pH 8.0 (Ambion/Thermo Fisher Scientific AM9856)
Triton X-100 (Molecular biology grade, Sigma T8787)
Molecular Biology Grade Ethanol (Sigma E7023 or equivalent)
Millimark mouse anti-NeuN monoclonal antibody clone A60, PE conjugated (EMD Millipore FCMAB317PE)
PE mouse IgG1k isotype control (BD Biosciences, 550617)
Bottle-top vacuum filter system; 0.22 µm pore size, 250 ml (EMD Millipore, Millipore Steritop or equivalent) or 0.45 µm (Corning 430516 purchased as VWR 28199-814, 28199-818 or equivalent)
Syringe filter, 0.22 µm (EMD Millipore, Millex PES 30mm sterile syringe filters, SLGP033RB or equivalent)

steps.title: Aliquot 30% BSA
steps.instruction: Using a P1000 pipette, dispense 1 ml of 30 % BSA into each PCR‑grade RNase‑free 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube; keep aliquots at 4 °C for up to 30 days or at –20 °C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Make 10% Triton X‑100 Solution
steps.instruction: Measure 18 ml nuclease‑free water into a 50 ml conical tube, add 2 ml Triton X‑100, vortex until dissolved, let sit at room temperature for 20 min, filter through a 0.22 µm syringe filter into a clean tube, label, and store at 4 °C for up to 30 days.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Media
steps.instruction: In a 250 ml RNase‑free bottle, combine 200 ml nuclease‑free water, 2.5 ml 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 8.0 (final 10 mM), 21.45 g sucrose (final 250 mM), 3.13 ml 2 M KCl (final 25 mM), and 1.25 ml 1 M MgCl₂ (final 5 mM); shake until sucrose dissolves, adjust volume to 250 ml with water, filter through a 0.22 µm (or 0.45 µm) filter, attach filter to a 1 L filter flask with Tygon tubing, apply vacuum, and store at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks.

steps.title: Dissolve Protease Inhibitor Cocktail
steps.instruction: Remove 50X protease inhibitor cocktail from the –20 °C freezer, add 1 ml molecular‑biology‑grade 100 % ethanol with a P1000 pipette, pipette up/down 5–10 times to dissolve, transfer to a PCR‑grade 1.5 ml tube, and store at 4 °C for up to 30 days.

steps.title: Prepare DAPI Stock Solutions
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 mg DAPI in 10 ml nuclease‑free water to make a 1 mg/ml stock; aliquot 1 ml into RNase‑free 1.5 ml tubes, freeze at –20 °C for up to 6 months. For use, thaw an aliquot and dilute 1:10 with nuclease‑free water to 0.1 mg/ml (0.1 µg/µl); store the diluted stock at 4 °C for up to 1 month (the 1 mg/ml stock can be kept at 4 °C for up to 3 months).

steps.title: Prepare Blocking Buffer
steps.instruction: In a 15 ml conical tube, mix 8.733 ml nuclease‑free water, 1 ml 10X PBS pH 7.4, 267 µl 30 % BSA (final 0.8 %), and 50 µl 40 U/µl RNasin Plus (final 0.5 % w/v, 0.2 U/µl); invert 5–10 times to mix. Make fresh on the day of use and keep on ice or at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Homogenization Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine 24.125 ml NIM (from step 3), 25 µl 100 mM DTT (final 0.1 mM), 500 µl 50X protease inhibitor (final 1X), 125 µl 40 U/µl RNasin Plus (final 0.5 % w/v, 0.2 U/µl), and 250 µl 10 % Triton X‑100 (final 0.1 %); invert 5–10 times to mix. Prepare fresh on the day of use and keep on ice or at 4 °C.

steps.title: Condition Dounce Homogenizers
steps.instruction: Soak dounce homogenizers in RNase Away overnight, rinse thoroughly with MilliQ water, rinse once with nuclease‑free water, dry on clean kimwipes, wrap body and pestles in clean kimwipes, place in a clean RNase‑free container, and store in a 4 °C fridge for at least 30 minutes before use.

steps.title: Add Homogenization Buffer to Tissue
steps.instruction: If using frozen tissue, remove the 50–150 mg piece from –80 °C, place on wet ice, and add 1 ml homogenization buffer; thaw on wet ice. If using microdissected sections, discard the original buffer and add 1 ml homogenization buffer.

steps.title: Dounce Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Place the tissue and buffer in a chilled dounce, insert the loose pestle, and perform 10 strokes while keeping the pestle submerged and the dounce on wet ice. Then replace the loose pestle with the tight pestle and perform another 10 strokes under the same conditions.

steps.title: Filter Homogenate Through 30 µm Strainer
steps.instruction: Add an additional 2 ml homogenization buffer to the dounce (total 3 ml per sample), transfer the homogenate with a P1000 tip into a 15 ml conical tube, and pass it through a 30 µm cell strainer to remove large debris.

steps.title: Centrifuge to Pellet Nuclei
steps.instruction: Spin the filtered homogenate at 4 °C for 10 minutes at 900 × g in a refrigerated centrifuge; a visible pellet should form at the tube bottom.

steps.title: Resuspend Nuclei in Blocking Buffer
steps.instruction: Carefully remove supernatant, leaving ~50 µl above the pellet, discard the removed supernatant into a container with 10 % bleach, add 500 µl fresh blocking buffer, gently pipette up/down 5 times, and incubate on ice for up to 15 minutes.

steps.title: Optional Trypan Blue Viability Check
steps.instruction: Withdraw 10 µl of the nuclei suspension, mix with 10 µl 0.4 % Trypan Blue, incubate 1 minute at room temperature, load 10 µl into a disposable hemocytometer, and examine under an inverted phase‑contrast microscope to assess nuclear integrity and estimate yield.

steps.title: Set Up Control Tubes
steps.instruction: For each experiment prepare two controls: (a) DAPI‑only control – transfer 50 µl nuclei suspension to a clean 1.5 ml tube and add 450 µl blocking buffer (final volume 500 µl); (b) Isotype control – transfer 50 µl nuclei suspension from a different sample to a clean tube and add 450 µl blocking buffer. Keep the DAPI‑only tube on ice.

steps.title: Add Antibodies to Samples
steps.instruction: To each isotype control tube add 2 µl PE‑conjugated IgG1 k isotype antibody (final 1:250 dilution). To each NeuN‑labeling tube add 1 µl PE‑conjugated anti‑NeuN antibody (final 1:500 dilution). No antibody is added to the DAPI‑only control.

steps.title: Incubate Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Place all tubes (controls and samples) on a tube rotator inside a 4 °C refrigerator and rotate for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Wash and Resuspend Post‑Staining
steps.instruction: Spin all tubes at 4 °C for 5 minutes at 400 × g using a swinging‑bucket rotor; a pellet should be visible. Remove supernatant leaving ~50 µl, add 500 µl clean blocking buffer, gently pipette up/down 5 times to resuspend. Adjust final volume if needed for downstream FACS.

steps.title: Add DAPI for Final Stain
steps.instruction: Add DAPI from the 0.1 mg/ml stock to each tube to achieve a final concentration of 0.1 µg/ml (e.g., 1 µl of 0.1 mg/ml stock per 1 ml suspension); mix by gently tapping the tube.

steps.title: Filter Samples Before FACS
steps.instruction: Pass each stained sample through the cap of a 5 ml Polystyrene round‑bottom FACS tube to remove aggregates.

steps.title: Store Samples and Proceed to FACS
steps.instruction: Keep the filtered tubes on ice or at 4 °C until loading onto the flow cytometer.

steps.title: Dispose Waste and Clean Dounce
steps.instruction: Discard any unused blocking or homogenization buffer down the sink. Place all contaminated tissue, consumables, and waste in a Biohazard waste container. Clean dounce homogenizers by soaking in 10 % bleach for at least 20 minutes, rinse thoroughly with tap water, soak overnight in RNase Away, rinse with MilliQ water then nuclease‑free water, dry with clean kimwipes, wrap, and store at room temperature in a clean RNase‑free container until next use.
